answer_1.quote: We propose the Paraphrase Augmented Response Generation (PARG), an effective learning framework that jointly optimizes dialog paraphrase and dialog response generation.
answer_1.outputs: dialog responses and paraphrased user utterances

answer_2.quote: We use three metrics for evaluation following . Entity Match Rate (EMR) is the proportion that the system capture the correct user goal. Success F1 (Succ.F1) score measures whether the system can provide correct information requested by user. While these two metrics are used for evaluating system's task completion ability, we use BLEU to evaluate the language fluency of generated responses.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to further illustrate PARG's superiority in terms of paraphrase generation. In our experiments, we advise the judges to evaluate the quality of a paraphrase according to its similarity of user intent with the original utterance.
answer_4.guideline: Judges were asked to choose whether the paraphrase generated by PARG was better, equal, or worse than the baseline paraphrase in one-to-one comparisons.
